title: Large time intrinsic growth and asymptotic behavior for the classical Timoshenko system
summary: In this paper, we investigate the large time behavior of solutions to the classical Timoshenko system in the whole space $\mathbb{R}$. Although the system is conservative and its natural energy is conserved in time, the transversal displacement $\varphi$ and the rotation angle $ψ$ exhibit intrinsic polynomial growths. We establish sharp $L^p-L^q$ estimates for the solutions and show that the growth mechanism originates from the interaction between quadratic oscillations and singular low-frequency amplitudes of different orders.
